description: This file contains C++ source code for loading and defining TorchScript models, including model definitions, import functions, and model instantiation functions for various models such as DeepAndWide, trivial, leaky ReLU, long, and signed_log1p.

methods.name: import_libs
methods.description: Imports a TorchScript class type into a compilation unit using a source object and class name.

methods.name: getDeepAndWideSciptModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a TorchScript module for the DeepAndWide model with specified number of features.

methods.name: getTrivialScriptModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a simple TorchScript module with a trivial forward function.

methods.name: getLeakyReLUScriptModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a TorchScript module with a leaky ReLU activation function.

methods.name: getLeakyReLUConstScriptModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a TorchScript module with a constant leaky ReLU activation function.

methods.name: getLongScriptModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a TorchScript module with a long sequence of relu operations.

methods.name: getSignedLog1pModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a TorchScript module performing abs, log1p, sign, and multiplication operations.
